maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is fees from asset-based wealth platforms, technology/operations outsourcing and investment management, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Clients are banks, advisors, asset managers, institutions and families paying platform and asset-management fees; not government-paid.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through platform clients and asset-based fees, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Outsourced wealth platform, operations and processing embedded in clients' core operations; switching means costly migration and operational risk.
